summary: Dependency-confusion beacon posts installer host identifiers to hardcoded bare-IP endpoint at install and import time
details: The package is a scoped shim (@ppa-web-components/ppa-navigation) whose index.js exports a no-op Proxy, so applications that resolve this name against the public registry build successfully while the beacon fires. package.json declares scripts.postinstall = "node beacon.cjs" and index.js calls require('./beacon.cjs').fire() at module load, so the beacon runs both on npm install and on any require of the package. beacon.cjs collects host identifiers (os.hostname(), install path, process.cwd(), process.version) and POSTs them as JSON to the hardcoded bare-IP endpoint http://185.158.107.175:8787/_ah/dc over cleartext HTTP. The destination is a bare IP unrelated to the package's declared purpose, is not caller-configurable, and the shape matches a dependency-confusion squat that silently reports successful resolution of a private-scope name on the public registry.
